_comment: Labeled fixtures for the classifier acceptance test (spec §3.5, acceptance #3). 'accept' lists permissible classifications; a page mixing a press kit with directive guidance must classify on the guidance.

labels.note: known plain-prose example: segmented audiences + channel/timing/geo directives + b-roll for ad use
standard press kit — logos, headshots, bios, contact
issue/platform page written to persuade voters directly
press kit mixed with a directive closing-message instruction
real-pattern red box: segment->channel media-buy directives explicitly addressed to 'paid communication' + ad assets (audience test PASSES -> positive)

AUDIENCE TEST case: directive ('ADD FOR NATIONAL PRESS RELEASE', 'background for reporters', 'not for publication') but addressed to the campaign's own press shop / journalists, NOT an outside spender -> not red-boxing
